items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: After the Bhote Koshi floods, 734 bodies have been recovered and more than 8,186 people rescued so far. About 2,498 remain unaccounted for, including over 400 foreigners, as search teams continue working in the affected districts.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, and teams have recovered 626 bodies while about 2400 people remain unaccounted for. Over 4450 people have been rescued so far, including more than 187 foreign nationals, with help arriving from India and China.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, killing many people and damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. Rescue teams have recovered 538 bodies so far, while 511 out of 632 people from 33 countries are still missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams have reached the mudslide site at Gyirong Port after it hit Wednesday morning. Three people have been killed and 558 remain missing, with more rescuers and supplies arriving.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, with 359 bodies recovered so far and many people still missing. Among those unaccounted for are 596 people from 33 countries.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal's foreign ministry has opened an emergency room to help with foreign nationals affected by the Rasuwa floods. Families can call or message +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 between 7am and 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India's foreign ministry has opened a 24-hour control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Contact numbers and WhatsApp lines are listed for the ministry and the embassies in Kathmandu and Beijing.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River in Nepal this morning, damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. So far 72 bodies have been recovered and 403 people from 25 countries are reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026

items.summary: Nepal Police keeps the official lists of people missing or found after the floods. Only they can confirm someone's status, not social media or volunteer sites.
items.citation: Nepal Police UDB — udb.nepalpolice.gov.np

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu is working with Nepali authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals hit by the flash floods in the Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi area. Families can reach the MEA control room in Delhi or the embassy on WhatsApp for help.
items.citation: Embassy of India, Kathmandu
